Thanks Kim — looping in a few legal points so we don't go back-and-forth with the broker:

- Certificate vs endorsement: a COI by itself is not proof of additional insured status for legal purposes — our legal team should provide the endorsement text or carrier-signed ISO endorsement reference. If the carrier will only issue a COI, request the carrier to reference the exact endorsement form (e.g., CG 20 10 or an equivalent) and confirm via signed insurer letter.
- Wording: avoid "its affiliates and agents" if the counterparty insists on open-ended affiliate language; favor listing the named entity and a defined affiliate scope or use "and its subsidiaries" with a defined definition in the exhibit. We can be flexible, but please confirm StormByte's tolerance on affiliates.
- Cyber limits: 5M requests us to check available umbrella placement if our current standalone cyber limits are lower; ops will confirm whether this is feasible with underwriting.
- Doc housekeeping: if we end up adding an endorsement reference to the Order Form, please confirm whether you want the endorsement text embedded in Exhibit A or as a separately attached schedule. Either is okay but embedding helps downstream procurement.

I'll draft a short endorsement text for broker submission — attaching a suggested insert (endorsement_text_draft.docx).

Aditya
